mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( SEQ INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, AGENT_ID VARCHAR(50), WATCHDOG_STATUS VARCHAR(10), WATCHDOG_INTERVAL INT(11), THREAD_LLT VARCHAR(1000), UPDATE_DATE DATETIME, ETC VARCHAR(256) )
mapper.select: SELECT AGENT_ID AS agent_id, WATCHDOG_STATUS AS watchdog_status, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL AS watchdog_interval, THREAD_LLT AS thread_loop_time, DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS update_date, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS db_date FROM ${tableName} WHERE WATCHDOG_STATUS = #{watchdogStatus} ORDER BY AGENT_ID
